title: Better Resource Monitor vs iStat Menus
description: iStat Menus is a deeper system suite. Better Resource Monitor is the simpler, lighter option if you mainly want CPU, memory, GPU, and network usage in your menu bar.
heading: Better Resource Monitor vs iStat Menus
intro: iStat Menus and Better Resource Monitor are built for different jobs. iStat Menus is a bigger system utility with more sensors, controls, and extra detail. Better Resource Monitor is for the simpler use case: keep CPU, memory, GPU, and network visible from the menu bar, notice unusual load quickly, and keep the monitor itself light enough to ignore.

sections.heading: Which one fits better
sections.body: If you want a full system suite with extra sensors and controls, iStat Menus covers more ground. If you mostly want a clean way to keep an eye on your Mac during the day, Better Resource Monitor is the more focused option. It sticks to CPU, memory, GPU, and network usage instead of trying to become a control panel for everything.

sections.heading: Why Better Resource Monitor stays lighter
sections.body: Better Resource Monitor uses under 0.1% CPU on Apple Silicon and around 15 MB of memory. That lower overhead comes from keeping the feature set tighter and skipping the always-on sensor polling that heavier monitoring apps rely on. It is built to stay open all day without feeling like one more thing your Mac has to carry.

sections.heading: Easy to install, easy to trust
sections.body: Better Resource Monitor installs like a normal Mac app and keeps the experience simple: no extra setup, no private APIs, and no background helper to think about. Most people will care more about the lighter footprint and cleaner focus, but those choices are part of why it feels straightforward.

sections.heading: Privacy
sections.body: Better Resource Monitor makes zero network requests. No analytics, no telemetry. Everything stays on your machine. If you want a monitor that quietly does its job and keeps to itself, that part is straightforward.

cta: If you want the broader suite, iStat Menus is still the bigger tool. If you want the simpler one, [Better Resource Monitor is free on the Mac App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/better-resource-monitor/id6758237306) and the source is on [GitHub](https://github.com/alexx855/better-resource-monitor).
